test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A borrows ₹7,500 for 4 years at 8% p.a. simple interest. B borrows the same amount at simple interest of 9% for the first year, 10% for the second year and 6% for the next two years. What is simple interest paid by A and B in total (in ₹)?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹7,500

Time for A (tA) = 4 years

Rate for A (rA) = 8% p.a.

Rate for B (rB₁) = 9% for the first year

Rate for B (rB₂) = 10% for the second year

Rate for B (rB₃) = 6% for the third and fourth years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times r times t}{100} 

**Calculations:**

SI for A:

SIA = dfrac{7500 times 8 times 4}{100} 

⇒ SIA = dfrac{240000}{100} 

⇒ SIA = ₹2400

SI for B:

SIB₁ = dfrac{7500 times 9 times 1}{100} 

⇒ SIB₁ = ₹675

SIB₂ = dfrac{7500 times 10 times 1}{100} 

⇒ SIB₂ = ₹750

SIB₃ = dfrac{7500 times 6 times 2}{100} 

⇒ SIB₃ = ₹900

Total SI for B:

SIB = SIB₁ + SIB₂ + SIB₃

⇒ SIB = ₹675 + ₹750 + ₹900

⇒ SIB = ₹2325

Total SI paid by A and B:

Total SI = SIA + SIB

⇒ Total SI = ₹2400 + ₹2325

⇒ Total SI = ₹4725

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
